data.title: Washry
data.description: An on-demand laundry and dry-cleaning app that works like Uber Eats for your clothes — connecting users with trusted local cleaners for seamless pickup, cleaning, and doorstep delivery.
highlights: Custom hamper creation and item selection before checkout
Real-time order tracking from pickup to delivery
Secure in-app payment and flexible payment options
Order history and saved preferences for faster reorders
